name: io.github.datenhaus/zato
title: zato crypto data
description: Crypto data for agents: token security, wallets, gas, prices, ENS, DeFi. Pay per call via x402.

tools.name: wallet_report
tools.description: One wallet on one chain: native + top token balances, nonce, contract flag, recent token transfers. network: ethereum (default), base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, avalanche, linea, scroll, zksync, gnosis, celo or solana. Accepts ENS/Basenames. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).

address.description: Wallet or contract address to report on (0x + 40 hex chars) or ENS/Basename (vitalik.eth, name.base.eth)

network.description: ethereum (default), base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, avalanche, linea, scroll, zksync, gnosis, celo or solana

tools.name: gas
tools.description: Current gas price and fee estimate (base fee, priority fee, transfer cost) on Ethereum or Base. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: token_risk
tools.description: Facts about an ERC-20 token contract: proxy, owner/renounced, mint/pause/blacklist/fee functions, supply. No score. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: payto_check
tools.description: Quick facts about a payTo wallet on Base/Ethereum: contract or EOA, nonce, ETH/USDC balance, recent USDC flow, optional domain declaration. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base).

address.description: payTo address to check (0x + 40 hex chars) or ENS/Basename (vitalik.eth, name.base.eth)

domain.description: optional seller domain, e.g. api.example.com: we GET its /.well-known/paycheck.json and /.well-known/x402.json (3 s timeout, public hosts only) and report whether the address is declared there

tools.name: usdc_balance
tools.description: Only the USDC balance of an address, on all 12 EVM chains or one. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: sanctions_check
tools.description: Is this crypto address (any chain) on the U.S. OFAC SDN sanctions list? Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: approvals_report
tools.description: Which contracts can still spend this wallet's tokens (open ERC-20 allowances, Ethereum/Base, recent window). Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: multichain_wallet_report
tools.description: One wallet across all 12 EVM chains at once (or a chains= subset): where does it hold funds and where is it active. Price: $0.008 USDC per call (x402, Base).

address.description: wallet or contract address (0x + 40 hex chars) or ENS/Basename (vitalik.eth, name.base.eth)

chains.description: optional comma-separated subset, e.g. ethereum,base,bnb (default: all 12 chains)

tools.name: tx
tools.description: One Ethereum transaction by hash: details plus receipt (status, gas, logs). Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: name_resolve
tools.description: ENS/Basename lookup both ways: name -> address, or address -> primary name. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base).

address.description: or an address for reverse lookup

tools.name: batch_wallet_report
tools.description: Up to 20 wallets (addresses or ENS names) on one chain in one call, for screening lists. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402, Base).

network.description: ethereum (default), base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, avalanche, linea, scroll, zksync, gnosis or celo

tools.name: counterparty_report
tools.description: Before paying or trusting an unknown address: pay-to facts + wallet age + presence on 12 chains in one answer. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base).

domain.description: optional seller domain to check the payTo declaration

tools.name: preflight
tools.description: Right before paying an x402 URL: decodes its 402 terms, checks the payTo wallet and whether the domain declares it. Never pays. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: wallet_age
tools.description: When did this address first become active (first outgoing tx / contract creation) on Ethereum, Base and Optimism. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: balance_at
tools.description: ETH and USDC balance of an address at a past date or block (Ethereum, Base, Optimism). Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).

block.description: or a block number instead of date

tools.name: contract_info
tools.description: Provenance of a contract: verified source?, name, compiler, creator, creation tx (Ethereum, zkSync, Celo). Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: nft_metadata
tools.description: What an NFT is: tokenURI plus fetched metadata (name, image, attributes) for ERC-721/1155. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: dns
tools.description: DNS records of a domain (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA, SOA) plus parsed SPF and DMARC. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Plausibility of an email address: syntax, MX, SPF, DMARC, role and disposable domain. No mailbox contact. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: page_markdown
tools.description: Readable content of a public web page as clean Markdown (robots.txt respected). Price: $0.0015 USDC per call (x402, Base).
